expectations_used.approach: Names the mechanism — the sweep releasing the original count rather than the remaining count — not merely "something in the sweep".

summary: The candidate ran the tests, guessed the sweep file was the culprit, made an edit, and got a green run within about two minutes. There was no visible clarification, hypothesis, or explanation of the mechanism at any point — just a quick poke-and-check cycle that happened to land on the right file and fix.

dimensions.analysis: The candidate went straight from a failing test run to guessing at a location without reading the failing test body or asking about expected behavior for partially shipped holds. No question was raised about what 'remaining vs original units' should mean before editing.

The stated plan was only a location guess ('something in the sweep file'), not a mechanism. There is no articulation of what specifically was wrong with the sweep logic (original count vs remaining count) before editing began.

Aside from a one-line guess at the start and a one-line celebration at the end, there is no narration during the 40-second stretch of reading and editing sweep.ts. An interviewer would have had no visibility into what was being traced or why the edit was made.

The candidate opened the correct file, made a single edit, saved it, and the previously failing suite passed — so the change was scoped and effective. However, since no mechanism was stated beforehand, it's not possible to judge how deliberately the edit targeted the actual remaining-vs-original-count defect versus trial and error.

They did re-run the full test suite after the edit and observed a pass before ending the session, which is a real verification step rather than a bare declaration. But there's no evidence they specifically checked the partially-shipped-hold test case or considered edge cases like full-release holds beyond the aggregate pass signal.

The closing remark is a bare acknowledgment that tests pass, with no articulation of why the sweep was releasing phantom stock or how the edit corrects the remaining-count computation. There's no connection drawn between the fix and the failure mechanism.
